purpose: New-case metadata/error/context capture only; original three failures remain UNKNOWN.

capture_yield.PASS: One correlated first prepare dispatch/outcome pair within the same dispatcher, exact writing classification and bounded identity/omission fields, static native/source classes and pre-Stop host context retained.
capture_yield.FAIL: Malformed or uncorrelated capture, observer/file overflow/failure, or forbidden raw payload retained.
capture_yield.UNKNOWN: No prepare, end/timeout before complete pair, missing/capped metadata or foreign/missing source class. A generic tool_rejected may narrow but need not identify a unique cause.

safety.PASS: Real checked Stop at first success/failure prepare outcome or before disallowed effect; no target change/Apply receipt, no inherited protected/MCP/helper authority, bounded cleanup with actual free lease.
safety.FAIL: Forbidden effect/Apply, changed target or receipt, hidden held lease, unreviewed route/grant, repeated workflow/start, or unsafe archive.
safety.UNKNOWN: Canonical/lease facts unavailable; do not infer a successful Stop from local cancellation.

allowed_before_prepare: Read tools and bounded retain_progress model-reported Run metadata only; reported plan is unverified.
not_scored: I01 completion, historical root cause, goal success, causal feature benefit or semantic superiority.
stop_policy: One reserved start maximum; no retry/Continue/replacement/automatic Apply. A capture gap ends the attempt.
